en: So you found your way through the sand. Not bad. Mudsdale and I came straight across.
These are the Ruins of Abundance. Tapu Bulu sleeps in there. People say it gives the land its harvests, and takes them back when it's cross.
Poni has a guardian too, but no kahuna. Not since my grandfather. Everyone is waiting for someone to step up.
Maybe someone will. I'm going home to find out. Come to Poni when you've finished here, {player}.
